text:
alex: Heads-up — planning to cut v3.4.0 today. Need final signoff on annotated tag + artifacts. Targeting 18:00 UTC. Anyone object?

maria: looks good to me, changelog done and uploaded. pushed changelog bump branch: release/chore/v3.4.0-bump

samir: CI found one flaky test but fixed in #4872, merged into release branch.

jen: quick reminder — cutoff is 17:30 UTC. after that we only accept hotfixes via cherry-picks.

alex: @release-bot can you confirm artifacts uploaded and checksums?

release-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-release-artifacts/v3.4.0/ — checksums file present: sha256sums.txt and sha256sums.txt.sig. All signatures verified :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: final pipeline passed on release branch: build, smoke, e2e. job id: 8921

maria: Tagging process I plan to run:

```
git checkout release/v3.4.0
git tag -a v3.4.0 -m "v3.4.0 — runtime fixes, batching improvements"
git push origin v3.4.0
gh release create v3.4.0 --draft --notes-file CHANGELOG.md
```

alex: @samir can you eyeball the annotated tag message? Also confirm we include manifest.json as release asset.

samir: message looks fine. manifest.json (artifact-manifest) includes checksums + signed by ops-sre key. I uploaded manifest to S3 and added it to draft release assets.

jen: don't forget to set prerelease=false and add release notes link. Also assign release to ops oncall.

alex: approving the tag and publish :shipit: 

maria: I'll create the gh release after 17:45 UTC and attach artifacts. tagging now in 5.

alex: thanks — ping here when done.

maria: tagged and pushed, draft created. URL: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v3.4.0 :eyes:

release-bot: draft release v3.4.0 created, assets attached: binaries.tar.gz, manifest.json, sha256sums.txt, sha256sums.txt.sig

jen: all good from security side — signatures verified and manifest checks out. Go ahead and publish after 18:00.

alex: publishing now.

maria: published. final checksum: abc123def456... (short). congrats :tada:

ops-sre: monitoring rollout — canaries green so far, latency within SLOs.

samir: filed patch to docs team to update supported-versions table.

alex: closing release thread. Thanks everyone.
